reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness console centered on supervising sub-agents and workflows, with supporting image-gallery, file, vision-service, Git, and themed UI features.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中监督多智能体与工作流，并提供图片图库、视觉模型调用和开发状态面板。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness console for supervising multi-agent workflows with an image gallery, vision-model integrations, and development status panels.

capabilities: Displays real-time status for primary and sub-agents, jobs, workflows, goals, logs, and errors
Sends messages to sub-agents and interrupts their current execution rounds
Uploads, imports, previews, deletes, and stores image files
Reads local image paths subject to the host file sandbox
Calls configurable OpenAI-compatible vision services using user-provided API keys
Uses host shell services for Git status and commit operations
